'''Arda Base Control''' was a group that was was responsible for directing ships that were preparing to land at [[Arda Base]], a process which ordinarily involved [[slave circuit]]ing. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Yalor]] was a member of the organization.<ref name="OAA1" />
